senses.definition: if you are in a world of your own, you are so concerned with your own thoughts that you do not notice what is happening around you

examples.x: I tapped on the window to get her attention but she was in a world of her own.

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn đang ở trong thế giới của riêng mình, bạn quá bận tâm đến suy nghĩ của mình đến nỗi bạn không nhận thấy những gì đang xảy ra xung quanh

senses.definition: used to express your surprise when you meet somebody you know in an unexpected place, or when you are talking to somebody and find out that you both know the same person
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để bày tỏ sự ngạc nhiên của bạn khi gặp ai đó quen biết ở một nơi bất ngờ, hoặc khi bạn đang nói chuyện với ai đó và phát hiện ra cả hai đều biết cùng một người

senses.definition: a person with a lot of experience of life, who is not easily surprised or shocked
senses.definition_vi: một người có nhiều kinh nghiệm sống, không dễ ngạc nhiên hay sốc.

senses.definition: not the worst thing that could happen to somebody

examples.x: Failing one exam is not the end of the world.
It won't be the end of the world if you don't get the job.

senses.definition_vi: không phải là điều tồi tệ nhất có thể xảy ra với ai đó.

senses.definition: used to say that you would never do something

examples.x: I wouldn't hurt you for the world.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng bạn sẽ không bao giờ làm điều gì đó.

senses.definition: used to refer to people of a particular type

examples.x: We all envy the Bill Gateses of this world (= the people who are as rich and successful as Bill Gates).

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để chỉ những người thuộc một loại cụ thể.

senses.definition: very happy or proud
senses.definition_vi: rất hạnh phúc hoặc tự hào.

senses.definition: used to emphasize how good, beautiful, etc. something is

examples.x: The meal was out of this world.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nhấn mạnh điều gì đó tốt đẹp, đẹp đẽ như thế nào.

senses.definition: to make promises that will be impossible to keep

examples.x: Politicians promise the earth before an election, but things are different afterwards.

senses.definition_vi: đưa ra những lời hứa không thể thực hiện được.

senses.definition: to travel widely and gain wide experience

examples.x: As a young man, he wanted to see the world before he settled down.

senses.definition_vi: đi du lịch nhiều nơi và tích lũy nhiều kinh nghiệm.

senses.definition: to be very successful and admired by other people

examples.x: He's never going to set the world on fire with his paintings.

senses.definition_vi: rất thành công và được người khác ngưỡng mộ.

senses.definition: to talk about how the world could be changed to be a better place

examples.x: We stayed up all night, setting the world to rights.

senses.definition_vi: nói về việc thế giới có thể thay đổi như thế nào để trở nên tốt đẹp hơn.

senses.definition: a state in which things are strange, mysterious or secret; a state that exists on the dividing line between two things

examples.x: the twilight world of the occult
The dissidents lived in a twilight world of hushed voices and secret meetings.
the twilight zone between living and merely existing
They lived in the twilight zone on the fringes of society.

senses.definition_vi: một trạng thái mà mọi thứ trở nên kỳ lạ, bí ẩn hoặc bí mật; một trạng thái tồn tại ở ranh giới giữa hai thứ.

senses.definition: to relax and watch people in a public place

examples.x: We sat outside a cafe, watching the world go by.
I love just watching the world go by.

senses.definition_vi: thư giãn và quan sát mọi người ở một nơi công cộng.

senses.definition: the way that most people behave; the way that things happen, which you cannot change

examples.x: The rich and powerful make the decisions—that's the way of the world.

senses.definition_vi: cách hầu hết mọi người cư xử; cách mọi thứ xảy ra mà bạn không thể thay đổi.

senses.definition: used to express dislike, surprise or shock, especially at changes in people’s attitudes or behaviour

examples.x: When I listen to the news these days, I sometimes wonder what the world is coming to.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để bày tỏ sự không thích, ngạc nhiên hoặc sốc, đặc biệt là trước những thay đổi trong thái độ hoặc hành vi của mọi người.

senses.definition: used to say that you cannot do something, even though you really want to

examples.x: With the best will in the world I could not describe him as a good father.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng bạn không thể làm điều gì đó, ngay cả khi bạn thực sự muốn.

senses.definition: everyone; a large number of people
senses.definition_vi: tất cả mọi người; một số lượng lớn người.

senses.definition: used to emphasize how different two things are

examples.x: His new luxury mansion was a world away from the tiny house where he was born.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nhấn mạnh hai thứ khác nhau như thế nào.

senses.definition: there is no limit to the opportunities open to you

examples.x: With talent like that, the world is her oyster.

senses.definition_vi: không có giới hạn nào đối với các cơ hội mở ra cho bạn.

senses.definition: used to emphasize how much difference there is between two things

examples.x: There's a world of difference between liking someone and loving them.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nhấn mạnh sự khác biệt lớn giữa hai thứ.

senses.definition: everywhere in the world

examples.x: People are basically the same the world over.
Scientists the world over have been waiting for this breakthrough.

senses.definition_vi: mọi nơi trên thế giới.

senses.definition: a situation in which you have all the possible disadvantages at the same time
senses.definition_vi: một tình huống mà bạn gặp phải tất cả những bất lợi có thể xảy ra cùng một lúc.

senses.definition: affecting all parts of the world

examples.x: an increase in worldwide sales
The show has a worldwide audience of 115 million viewers.
a worldwide terrorist network
The story has attracted worldwide attention.
a worldwide shortage of qualified engineers
The company employs 28 000 people worldwide.

senses.definition_vi: ảnh hưởng đến tất cả các nơi trên thế giới.

senses.definition: affecting all parts of the world

examples.x: an increase in worldwide sales
The show has a worldwide audience of 115 million viewers.
a worldwide terrorist network
The story has attracted worldwide attention.
a worldwide shortage of qualified engineers
The company employs 28 000 people worldwide.

senses.definition_vi: ảnh hưởng đến tất cả các nơi trên thế giới.

senses.definition: a long, thin creature with a soft body and no bones or legs

examples.x: birds looking for worms
Worms burrow down through the soil.

senses.definition_vi: một sinh vật dài, mảnh mai có cơ thể mềm và không có xương hoặc chân.

senses.definition: long, thin creatures that live inside the bodies of humans or animals and can cause illness

examples.x: The dog has worms.

senses.definition_vi: những sinh vật dài, mảnh mai sống bên trong cơ thể người hoặc động vật và có thể gây bệnh.

senses.definition: the young form of an insect when it looks like a short worm

examples.x: This apple is full of worms.

senses.definition_vi: dạng non của côn trùng khi nó trông giống như một con sâu ngắn.

senses.definition: a computer program that is a type of virus and that spreads across a network by copying itself
senses.definition_vi: một chương trình máy tính thuộc loại virus và lây lan qua mạng bằng cách tự sao chép.

senses.definition: a person you do not like or respect, especially because they have a weak character and do not behave well towards other people
senses.definition_vi: một người mà bạn không thích hoặc không tôn trọng, đặc biệt là vì họ có tính cách yếu đuối và không đối xử tốt với người khác.

senses.definition: if you open up a can of worms, you start doing something that will cause a lot of problems and be very difficult
senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn mở một hộp giun, bạn bắt đầu làm điều gì đó sẽ gây ra nhiều rắc rối và rất khó khăn.

senses.definition: the person who takes the opportunity to do something before other people will have an advantage over them
senses.definition_vi: người nắm lấy cơ hội để làm điều gì đó trước khi người khác có lợi thế hơn họ.

senses.definition: a person who is normally quiet and does not complain will protest when the situation becomes too hard to bear
senses.definition_vi: một người bình thường im lặng và không phàn nàn sẽ phản đối khi tình huống trở nên quá khó chịu.

senses.definition: thinking about unpleasant things that have happened or that might happen and therefore feeling unhappy and afraid

examples.x: Don't look so worried!
I'm not worried about her—she can take care of herself.
Doctors are worried about the possible spread of the disease.
People are really worried about losing their jobs.
He is extremely worried for her safety.
I was worried for my family.
We're not too worried by these results.
The police are worried that the man may be armed.
I was worried you wouldn't come.
Where have you been? I've been worried sick (= extremely worried).
Try not to get worried.
His worried parents were waiting for him when he got home.
She gave me a worried look.

senses.definition_vi: đang suy nghĩ về những điều khó chịu đã xảy ra hoặc có thể xảy ra và do đó cảm thấy không vui và sợ hãi.

senses.definition: used to tell somebody that you were worried because you had not understood what they had said correctly

examples.x: You had me worried for a moment—I thought you were going to resign!

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói với ai đó rằng bạn đã lo lắng vì bạn đã không hiểu đúng những gì họ nói.

senses.definition: the state of worrying about something

examples.x: The threat of losing their jobs is a constant source of worry to them.
A heart attack can be brought on by stress and worry.
Levels of worry about crime had fallen by a third.
to be frantic with worry
She couldn't sleep with worry.

senses.definition_vi: trạng thái lo lắng về điều gì đó.

senses.definition: something that worries you

examples.x: You need have no worries—everything's been taken care of.
worries about the future
She expressed some worries about working with him.
Mugging is a real worry for many old people.
There was the nagging worry that he wouldn't be able to match his past successes.
My only worry is that…
The biggest worry is that further stock market falls might dent consumer confidence.
money/financial worries
The news of his release from prison added further to her worries.
Students should discuss any problems or worries they have with their course tutors.

senses.definition_vi: một điều gì đó khiến bạn lo lắng.

senses.definition: it’s not a problem; it’s all right (often used as a reply when somebody thanks you for something)

examples.x: No worries—there's plenty of time.

senses.definition_vi: không phải là vấn đề; ổn thôi (thường được dùng để trả lời khi ai đó cảm ơn bạn vì điều gì đó).

senses.definition: to keep thinking about unpleasant things that might happen or about problems that you have

examples.x: Don't worry. We have plenty of time.
Stop worrying, Dad—it'll be fine.
Don't worry about me. I'll be all right.
He's always worrying about his weight.
Never mind—it's nothing to worry about.
That's not something you need to worry about.
You can stay here tonight, so you don't have to worry about walking home in the dark.
There's no point in worrying over things you can't change.
She's my sister, and I worry for her safety.
She began to worry for her friend.
I worry that I won't get into college.

senses.definition_vi: liên tục suy nghĩ về những điều khó chịu có thể xảy ra hoặc về những vấn đề bạn đang gặp phải.

senses.definition: to make somebody/yourself anxious about somebody/something

examples.x: What worries me is how I am going to get another job.
That prospect worried investors.
Don't worry yourself about it—I'll deal with it.
He's worried himself sick (= become extremely anxious) about his daughter.
Where have you been? I've been worrying myself silly (= been extremely anxious) all evening.
It worries me that he hasn't come home yet.

examples.cf: it worries somebody to do something
examples.x: It worried me to think what might happen.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó/chính mình lo lắng về ai đó/điều gì đó.

senses.definition: to annoy or upset somebody

examples.x: The noise never seems to worry her.
Don't keep worrying him with a lot of silly questions.
I didn't want to worry you with all the details.
Don't worry the driver with unnecessary requests.

senses.definition_vi: làm phiền hoặc buồn lòng ai đó.

senses.definition: to attack animals, especially sheep, by running after and/or biting them
senses.definition_vi: tấn công động vật, đặc biệt là cừu, bằng cách chạy đuổi theo và/hoặc cắn chúng.

senses.definition: it is not important; it does not matter

examples.x: Not to worry—I can soon fix it.
Not to worry—no harm done.

senses.definition_vi: nó không quan trọng; nó không thành vấn đề

senses.definition: of poorer quality or lower standard; more unpleasant

examples.x: The rooms were awful and the food was worse.
The weather got worse during the day.
I've been to far worse places.
The film was no worse than many others he made in the 1930s.
The interview was much worse than he had expected.
The area seemed almost worse than the city he had left.
There's nothing worse than going out in the cold with wet hair.
It's much worse for the parents than it is for the child.

senses.definition_vi: có chất lượng kém hơn hoặc tiêu chuẩn thấp hơn; khó chịu hơn

senses.definition: more serious or severe

examples.x: They were trying to prevent an even worse tragedy.
The crisis was getting worse and worse.
Don't tell her that—you'll only make things worse.
Could things get any worse?
Never mind—it could be worse (= although the situation is bad, it is not as bad as it might have been).
The situation was worse than he had imagined.
It's not just the government's poor ratings in the opinion polls. It's worse than that.
Killing someone is considered morally worse than letting them die.

senses.definition_vi: nghiêm trọng hoặc nặng hơn

senses.definition: more ill or unhappy

examples.x: If he gets any worse, we'll call the doctor.
He told her she'd let them down and she felt worse than ever.
She seems worse than she was yesterday.

senses.definition_vi: ốm yếu hoặc không hạnh phúc hơn

senses.definition: used to say that somebody is not really as angry or as aggressive as they sound
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng ai đó không thực sự tức giận hoặc hung hăng như họ tỏ ra

senses.definition: to lose a fight, competition, etc. or suffer more compared with others
senses.definition_vi: thua trong một cuộc chiến, cuộc thi, v.v. hoặc chịu đựng nhiều hơn so với những người khác

senses.definition: a terrible thing that could happen

examples.x: At the last minute she was saved from a fate worse than death.

senses.definition_vi: một điều tồi tệ có thể xảy ra

senses.definition: to get even worse
senses.definition_vi: trở nên tồi tệ hơn nữa

senses.definition: used to show that you are disappointed about something

examples.x: I shall have to miss the party, worse luck!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho thấy bạn thất vọng về điều gì đó

senses.definition: less well

examples.x: Working-class children fared rather worse.
They are performing much worse than their counterparts at competitor firms.
I didn't do it very well, but, if anything, he did it worse than I did.

senses.definition_vi: kém hơn

senses.definition: more seriously or severely

examples.x: It's raining worse than ever.
These workers were treated worse than animals.

senses.definition_vi: nghiêm trọng hoặc nặng hơn

senses.definition: used to introduce a statement about something that is more serious or unpleasant than things already mentioned

examples.x: She'd lost her job. Even worse, she'd lost her house and her children, too.
The defeat in Parliament has undermined his authority. Worse than that, everybody's now questioning his judgement.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để giới thiệu một tuyên bố về điều gì đó nghiêm trọng hoặc khó chịu hơn những điều đã được đề cập trước đó

senses.definition: to be poorer, unhappier, etc. than before or than somebody else

examples.x: The increase in taxes means that we'll be £30 a month worse off than before.
I've only broken my arm; other people are far worse off than me.

senses.definition_vi: kém hơn, bất hạnh hơn, v.v. so với trước đây hoặc so với người khác

senses.definition: used to say that you think something is a good idea

examples.x: If you want a safe investment, you could do a lot worse than put your money in a building society.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng bạn nghĩ điều gì đó là một ý tưởng hay

senses.definition: more problems or bad news

examples.x: I'm afraid there is worse to come.
McPherson was sent off for a tackle on Mendes. Worse followed when Yardley gave Saints the lead.

senses.definition_vi: nhiều vấn đề hoặc tin xấu hơn

senses.definition: to not be harmed by something

examples.x: The kids were none the worse for their adventure.

senses.definition_vi: không bị tổn hại bởi điều gì đó

senses.definition: a person, thing, situation, etc. that is better/worse than the previous or present one

examples.x: Voters see the new leader as a change for the better.
I reckon we've all made a big change for the better.
His family had detected a change for the worse in his behaviour.

senses.definition_vi: một người, vật, tình huống, v.v. tốt hơn/tệ hơn so với cái trước đó hoặc cái hiện tại

senses.definition: used to say that something cannot be changed, whether the result is good or bad
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng điều gì đó không thể thay đổi, dù kết quả tốt hay xấu

senses.definition: used to say that something is even better/worse

examples.x: We don't actually need it on Tuesday, but if it arrives by then, so much the better.
If hurricanes become more powerful, as current research suggests, so much the worse.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng điều gì đó thậm chí còn tốt hơn/tệ hơn

senses.definition: in a poor condition because of being used a lot
senses.definition_vi: trong tình trạng tồi tệ do được sử dụng nhiều

senses.definition: drunk

examples.x: He arrived home at two in the morning, much the worse for wear.

senses.definition_vi: say rượu

senses.definition: the practice of showing respect for God or a god, by saying prayers, singing with others, etc.; a ceremony for this

examples.x: an act/a place of worship
morning/evening worship (= a church service in the morning/evening)
The tradition of ancestor worship stretches back thousands of years.

senses.definition_vi: việc thể hiện sự tôn kính đối với Chúa hoặc một vị thần, bằng cách cầu nguyện, hát cùng người khác, v.v.; một buổi lễ cho việc này

senses.definition: a strong feeling of love and respect for somebody/something

examples.x: What she feels for him is akin to worship.

senses.definition_vi: một cảm giác mạnh mẽ về tình yêu và sự tôn trọng đối với ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: a polite way of addressing or referring to a magistrate or mayor
senses.definition_vi: một cách lịch sự để xưng hô hoặc đề cập đến một thẩm phán hoặc thị trưởng

senses.definition: to show respect for God or a god, especially by saying prayers, singing, etc. with other people in a religious building

examples.x: The Mayans built jungle pyramids to worship their gods.

senses.definition_vi: thể hiện sự tôn kính đối với Chúa hoặc một vị thần, đặc biệt là bằng cách cầu nguyện, hát, v.v. với những người khác trong một tòa nhà tôn giáo

senses.definition: to go to a service in a religious building

examples.x: We worship at St Mary's.
He worshipped at the local mosque.

senses.definition_vi: đi đến một buổi lễ trong một tòa nhà tôn giáo

senses.definition: to love and admire somebody very much, especially so much that you cannot see their faults

examples.x: She worships her children.
He worshipped her from afar (= he loved her but did not tell her his feelings).
She worships the ground he walks on.

senses.definition_vi: yêu mến và ngưỡng mộ ai đó rất nhiều, đặc biệt là đến mức bạn không thể nhìn thấy những lỗi lầm của họ

senses.definition: of the poorest quality or lowest standard; worse than any other person or thing of a similar kind

examples.x: It was by far the worst speech he had ever made.
It's not the worst idea I've ever heard.
What's the worst thing that could happen?
What she said confirmed my worst fears (= proved they were right).
This is every parent's worst nightmare.

senses.definition_vi: có chất lượng kém nhất hoặc tiêu chuẩn thấp nhất; tệ hơn bất kỳ người hoặc vật tương tự nào khác

senses.definition: to be the cause of your own problems

examples.x: Her indecisiveness makes her her own worst enemy.
Some dancers become their own worst enemies, criticizing themselves for every imperfection.

senses.definition_vi: là nguyên nhân gây ra vấn đề của chính mình

senses.definition: to lose a fight, competition, etc. or suffer more compared with others
senses.definition_vi: thua trong một cuộc chiến, cuộc thi, v.v. hoặc chịu đựng nhiều hơn so với những người khác

senses.definition: most badly or seriously

examples.x: He was voted the worst dressed celebrity.
Manufacturing industry was worst affected by the fuel shortage.
Singapore has been among the countries worst hit by the virus.
The report depicts British teenagers as the worst behaved in Europe.
Worst of all, I lost the watch my father had given me.

senses.definition_vi: một cách tồi tệ hoặc nghiêm trọng nhất

senses.definition: the most serious or unpleasant thing that could happen; the part, situation, possibility, etc. that is worse than any other

examples.x: When they did not hear from her, they feared the worst.
It doesn't matter what I say. My mother always expects the worst.
The worst of it is that I can't even be sure if they received my letter.
Although all the votes have not yet been counted, the party is preparing for the worst.
This is politics at its worst.
If the worst happens, at least you're prepared.
The worst of the storm was over.
He was always optimistic, even when things were at their worst.

senses.definition_vi: điều nghiêm trọng hoặc khó chịu nhất có thể xảy ra; phần, tình huống, khả năng, v.v. tệ hơn bất kỳ điều gì khác

senses.definition: used for saying what is the worst thing that can happen

examples.x: At the very worst, he'll have to pay a fine.
At worst this may mean the end of her playing career.
At worst, the drug can be fatal.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói điều gì là điều tồi tệ nhất có thể xảy ra

senses.definition: to make somebody show their worst qualities

examples.x: Pressure can bring out the worst in people.
Christmas usually brings out the absolute worst in sentimental platitudes.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó thể hiện những phẩm chất tồi tệ nhất của họ

senses.definition: to do as much damage or be as unpleasant as possible

examples.x: Let them do their worst—we'll fight them every inch of the way.

senses.definition_vi: gây ra nhiều thiệt hại nhất hoặc khó chịu nhất có thể

senses.definition: to be defeated

examples.x: He'd been in a fight and had obviously got the worst of it.

senses.definition_vi: bị đánh bại

senses.definition: if the situation becomes too difficult or dangerous

examples.x: If the worst comes to the worst, we'll just have to sell the house.

senses.definition_vi: nếu tình hình trở nên quá khó khăn hoặc nguy hiểm

senses.definition: a situation in which you have all the possible disadvantages at the same time
senses.definition_vi: một tình huống mà bạn có tất cả những bất lợi có thể xảy ra cùng một lúc

senses.definition: having a value in money, etc.

examples.x: Our house is worth about £100 000.
How much is this painting worth?
to be worth a bomb/packet/fortune (= a lot of money)
It isn't worth much.
If you answer this question correctly, it's worth five points.
This order is potentially worth millions of pounds to the company.

senses.definition_vi: có giá trị bằng tiền, v.v.

senses.definition: used to recommend the action mentioned because you think it may be useful, pleasant, etc.

examples.x: The museum is certainly worth a visit.
This idea is well worth considering.
It's so unimportant it's hardly worth mentioning.
It's worth making an appointment before you go.
It's always worth paying the extra £3 for next-day delivery.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để giới thiệu hành động được đề cập vì bạn nghĩ rằng nó có thể hữu ích, thú vị, v.v.

senses.definition: important, good or pleasant enough to make somebody feel satisfied, especially when difficulty or effort is involved

examples.x: Was it worth the effort?
The new house really wasn't worth all the expense involved.
The job involves a lot of hard work but it's worth it.
The trip was expensive but it was worth every penny.
The film is definitely worth seeing.

senses.definition_vi: quan trọng, tốt hoặc dễ chịu đủ để khiến ai đó cảm thấy hài lòng, đặc biệt là khi có khó khăn hoặc nỗ lực liên quan.

senses.definition: having money and possessions of a particular value

examples.x: He's worth £10 million.

senses.definition_vi: có tiền và tài sản có giá trị nhất định.

senses.definition: it is better to keep something that you already have than to risk losing it by trying to get much more
senses.definition_vi: tốt hơn nên giữ những gì bạn đã có hơn là mạo hiểm mất nó bằng cách cố gắng có được nhiều hơn.

senses.definition: in a very determined way, with great energy and effort

examples.x: He was rowing for all he was worth.

senses.definition_vi: một cách rất quyết tâm, với năng lượng và nỗ lực lớn.

senses.definition: in order to get as much as you can from somebody/something

examples.x: She is milking her success for all it's worth.

senses.definition_vi: để lấy được nhiều nhất có thể từ ai đó/điều gì đó.

senses.definition: used to emphasize that what you are saying is only your own opinion or suggestion and may not be very helpful

examples.x: I prefer this colour, for what it's worth.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nhấn mạnh rằng những gì bạn đang nói chỉ là ý kiến hoặc gợi ý của riêng bạn và có thể không hữu ích lắm.

senses.definition: not worth doing because it is against the rules or because it might cause you to lose your job

examples.x: It's more than my job's worth to let you in without a ticket.

senses.definition_vi: không đáng làm vì nó trái với quy tắc hoặc vì nó có thể khiến bạn bị mất việc.

senses.definition: the advantages to be gained from doing something are not great enough, considering the effort or cost involved

examples.x: If the price goes up again, he may decide that the game’s not worth the candle.

senses.definition_vi: những lợi ích thu được từ việc làm điều gì đó không đủ lớn, xét đến nỗ lực hoặc chi phí bỏ ra.

senses.definition: having no value, especially legally, or because one of the people involved has no intention of doing what they said they would
senses.definition_vi: không có giá trị, đặc biệt là về mặt pháp lý, hoặc vì một trong những người liên quan không có ý định thực hiện những gì họ đã nói sẽ làm.

senses.definition: deserving respect, especially because you do your job well

examples.x: Any teacher worth her salt knows that.

senses.definition_vi: xứng đáng được tôn trọng, đặc biệt là vì bạn làm tốt công việc của mình.

senses.definition: very useful or valuable

examples.x: A good mechanic is worth his weight in gold.

senses.definition_vi: rất hữu ích hoặc có giá trị.

senses.definition: interesting or useful for somebody to do

examples.x: It will be worth your while to come to the meeting.
He'll do the job if you make it worth his while (= pay him well).

senses.definition_vi: thú vị hoặc hữu ích cho ai đó để làm.

senses.definition: an amount of something that has the value mentioned

examples.x: The winner will receive fifty pounds' worth of books.
The floods caused tens of millions of pounds' worth of damage.
a dollar’s worth of change

senses.definition_vi: một lượng của một cái gì đó có giá trị được đề cập.

senses.definition: an amount of something that lasts a week, etc.
senses.definition_vi: một lượng của một cái gì đó kéo dài một tuần, v.v.

senses.definition: the financial, practical or moral value of somebody/something

examples.x: Their contribution was of great worth.
The activities help children to develop a sense of their own worth.
A good interview enables candidates to prove their worth (= show how good they are).

senses.definition_vi: giá trị tài chính, thực tế hoặc đạo đức của ai đó/điều gì đó.

senses.definition: to get enough value or pleasure out of something, considering the amount of money, time, etc. that you are spending on it

examples.x: Let’s spend all day there and really get our money’s worth.
The boat trip lasts three hours, so you certainly get your money's worth.

senses.definition_vi: để nhận được đủ giá trị hoặc niềm vui từ một điều gì đó, xét đến số tiền, thời gian, v.v. mà bạn đang chi cho nó.

senses.definition: to give your opinion about something, even if other people do not want to hear it
senses.definition_vi: để đưa ra ý kiến của bạn về một điều gì đó, ngay cả khi những người khác không muốn nghe.

senses.definition: important, pleasant, interesting, etc.; worth spending time, money or effort on

examples.x: It was in aid of a worthwhile cause (= a charity, etc.).
a worthwhile discussion/job
The smile on her face made it all worthwhile.
We all felt we had done something worthwhile for the local community.

examples.cf: worthwhile for somebody to do something
examples.x: High prices in the UK make it worthwhile for buyers to look abroad.
It is worthwhile to include really high-quality illustrations.
It didn't seem worthwhile writing it all out again.

senses.definition_vi: quan trọng, dễ chịu, thú vị, v.v.; đáng để dành thời gian, tiền bạc hoặc công sức.

senses.definition: having the qualities that deserve somebody/something

examples.x: Very few of his ideas are worthy of further attention.
A number of the report's findings are worthy of note.
No composer was considered worthy of the name until he had written an opera.
a worthy champion (= one who deserved to win)
He felt he was not worthy of her.

senses.definition_vi: có những phẩm chất xứng đáng với ai đó/điều gì đó.

senses.definition: having qualities that deserve your respect or attention

examples.x: The money we raise will be going to a very worthy cause.
a worthy member of the team
We thought it was a worthy enough objective.

senses.definition_vi: có những phẩm chất xứng đáng với sự tôn trọng hoặc chú ý của bạn.

senses.definition: having good qualities but not very interesting or exciting

examples.x: her worthy but dull husband
He's a very worthy man, I suppose, but he's very dull.

senses.definition_vi: có những phẩm chất tốt nhưng không rất thú vị hoặc hấp dẫn.

senses.definition: typical of what a particular person or thing might do, give, etc.

examples.x: He gave a speech that was worthy of Martin Luther King.

senses.definition_vi: điển hình cho những gì một người hoặc vật cụ thể có thể làm, cho, v.v.

senses.definition: deserving, or suitable for, the thing mentioned

examples.x: trustworthy
roadworthy

senses.definition_vi: xứng đáng, hoặc phù hợp với, điều được đề cập.

senses.definition: used in polite offers or invitations

examples.x: Would you like a sandwich?
Would you have dinner with me on Friday?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng trong các lời đề nghị hoặc lời mời lịch sự.

senses.definition: used to say what you like, love, hate, etc.

examples.cf: would like, love, hate, prefer, etc. something
examples.x: I'd love a coffee.

examples.cf: would like, etc. to do something
examples.x: I'd be only too glad to help.

examples.cf: would like, etc. somebody to do something
examples.x: I'd hate you to think I was criticizing you.
I'd rather come with you.
I'd rather you came with us.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói những gì bạn thích, yêu, ghét, v.v.

senses.definition: used as the past form of will when reporting what somebody has said or thought

examples.x: He said he would be here at eight o'clock (= His words were: ‘I will be there at eight o'clock.’).
She asked if I would help.
They told me that they probably wouldn't come.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng làm dạng quá khứ của 'will' khi báo cáo những gì ai đó đã nói hoặc suy nghĩ.

senses.definition: used for talking about the result of an event that you imagine

examples.x: She'd look better with shorter hair.
If you went to see him, he would be delighted.
Hurry up! It would be a shame to miss the beginning of the play.
She'd be a fool to accept it (= if she accepted).

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói về kết quả của một sự kiện mà bạn tưởng tượng.

senses.definition: used for describing a possible action or event that did not in fact happen, because something else did not happen first

examples.x: If I had seen the advertisement in time, I would have applied for the job.
They would never have met if she hadn't gone to Emma's party.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để mô tả một hành động hoặc sự kiện có thể xảy ra nhưng trên thực tế đã không xảy ra, vì một điều gì đó khác đã không xảy ra trước đó.

senses.definition: used for saying why somebody does something

examples.cf: so that somebody/something would do something
examples.x: She burned the letters so that her husband would never read them.

examples.cf: in order that somebody/something would do something
examples.x: He worked hard in order that he would pass all his exams.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói lý do tại sao ai đó làm điều gì đó.

senses.definition: used for saying what you want to happen

examples.x: I wish that you'd be quiet for a minute.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói những gì bạn muốn xảy ra.

senses.definition: used to show that somebody/something was not willing or refused to do something

examples.x: She wouldn't change it, even though she knew it was wrong.
My car wouldn't start this morning.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ ra rằng ai đó/điều gì đó không sẵn lòng hoặc từ chối làm điều gì đó.

senses.definition: used to ask somebody politely to do something

examples.x: Would you mind leaving us alone for a few minutes?
Would you open the door for me, please?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để lịch sự yêu cầu ai đó làm điều gì đó.

senses.definition: used to give opinions that you are not certain about

examples.x: I would imagine the job will take about two days.
I'd say he was about fifty.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để đưa ra ý kiến mà bạn không chắc chắn.

senses.definition: used to give advice

examples.x: I wouldn't have any more to drink, if I were you.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để đưa ra lời khuyên.

senses.definition: used for talking about things that often happened in the past

examples.x: When my parents were away, my grandmother would take care of me.
He'd always be the first to offer to help.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói về những điều thường xảy ra trong quá khứ.

senses.definition: used for talking about behaviour that you think is typical

examples.x: ‘She said it was your fault.’ ‘Well, she would say that, wouldn't she? She's never liked me.’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói về hành vi mà bạn cho là điển hình.

senses.definition: used to express a strong wish

examples.x: Would that he had lived to see it.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để diễn tả một mong muốn mạnh mẽ.

senses.definition: an injury to part of the body, especially one in which a hole is made in the skin using a weapon

examples.x: a gunshot/stab wound
a bullet/knife/shrapnel wound
a head/leg wound
an old war wound
The nurse cleaned the wound.
The wound healed slowly.
He died of his wounds.
He suffered a fatal wound to the abdomen.
He died from the wounds he had received to his chest.

senses.definition_vi: một vết thương ở một bộ phận của cơ thể, đặc biệt là một vết thương có lỗ trên da do vũ khí gây ra.

senses.definition: mental or emotional pain caused by something unpleasant that has been said or done to you

examples.x: Seeing him again opened up old wounds.
They say that time heals all wounds.
After a serious argument, it can take some time for the wounds to heal.
The incident remains a festering wound.

senses.definition_vi: nỗi đau về tinh thần hoặc tình cảm do điều gì đó khó chịu đã được nói hoặc làm với bạn.

senses.definition: to spend time trying to get your strength or confidence back after a defeat or a disappointing experience

examples.x: Leeds are still licking their wounds after their humiliating defeat by Grimsby.

senses.definition_vi: dành thời gian để lấy lại sức mạnh hoặc sự tự tin sau một thất bại hoặc một trải nghiệm đáng thất vọng.

senses.definition: to remind somebody of something unpleasant that happened or existed in the past

examples.x: His comments have served only to reopen old wounds.

senses.definition_vi: nhắc nhở ai đó về điều gì đó khó chịu đã xảy ra hoặc tồn tại trong quá khứ

senses.definition: to make a difficult experience even more difficult for somebody
senses.definition_vi: làm cho một trải nghiệm khó khăn trở nên khó khăn hơn đối với ai đó

senses.definition: to injure part of the body, especially by making a hole in the skin using a weapon

examples.x: He had been wounded in the arm.
The driver was seriously wounded in the shooting.
Two soldiers were wounded in yesterday's fighting.
She was fatally wounded in the attack.
His leg had been badly wounded in the helicopter crash.

senses.definition_vi: làm tổn thương một bộ phận cơ thể, đặc biệt là bằng cách tạo ra một lỗ trên da bằng vũ khí

senses.definition: to hurt somebody’s feelings

examples.x: She had been deeply wounded by his remarks.
Friends say he has been wounded by the criticism.
Their indifference wounded him.
You wounded his pride.
It seemed to me I had wounded her ego.

senses.definition_vi: làm tổn thương tình cảm của ai đó

senses.definition: used to show that you are very surprised or impressed by somebody/something

examples.x: Wow! You look terrific!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để thể hiện rằng bạn rất ngạc nhiên hoặc ấn tượng bởi ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: to cover something completely in paper or other material, for example when you are giving it as a present

examples.x: He spent the evening wrapping up the Christmas presents.
individually wrapped chocolates
Each apple was wrapped in paper.
The cheese is cut and wrapped in plastic.
fish and chips wrapped up in newspaper

senses.definition_vi: bọc hoàn toàn một thứ gì đó bằng giấy hoặc vật liệu khác, ví dụ khi bạn tặng nó như một món quà

senses.definition: to cover something/somebody in material, for example in order to protect it/them

examples.x: Wrap the meat in foil before you cook it.
I wrapped the baby up in a blanket.
He tossed her a towel. ‘Wrap yourself in that.’
She wrapped herself up in a long shawl.
I wrapped a blanket around the baby.

senses.definition_vi: bọc một thứ gì đó/ai đó bằng vật liệu, ví dụ để bảo vệ nó/họ

senses.definition: to put something around something/somebody

examples.x: A scarf was wrapped around his neck.
The nurse wrapped a bandage tightly around my ankle.
His arms were wrapped around her waist.
He wrapped his arms tightly around her waist.
He wrapped his hands around my neck and tried to strangle me.
She's got a towel wrapped around her head.

senses.definition_vi: đặt một thứ gì đó quanh một thứ gì đó/ai đó

senses.definition: to cause a word or text to be carried over to a new line as the end of the previous line is reached by the writer; to be carried over in this way

examples.x: How can I wrap the text around?
The text wraps around if it is too long to fit the screen.

senses.definition_vi: khiến một từ hoặc văn bản bị xuống dòng khi kết thúc dòng trước đó đạt đến người viết; bị xuống dòng theo cách này

senses.definition: to be so involved with somebody/something that you do not pay enough attention to other people or things

examples.x: They are completely wrapped up in their children.
She was so wrapped up in her work that she didn’t realize how late it was.

senses.definition_vi: quá bận tâm với ai đó/điều gì đó đến mức bạn không chú ý đủ đến những người hoặc điều khác

senses.definition: to persuade somebody to do anything that you want

examples.x: She has always been able to wrap her parents around her little finger.

senses.definition_vi: thuyết phục ai đó làm bất cứ điều gì bạn muốn

senses.definition: the joint between the hand and the arm

examples.x: She's broken her wrist.
He wore a copper bracelet on his wrist.

senses.definition_vi: khớp nối giữa bàn tay và cánh tay

senses.definition: a warning or mild punishment

examples.x: We're hoping that she gets off with a slap on the wrist from the judge.

senses.definition_vi: một lời cảnh báo hoặc hình phạt nhẹ

senses.definition: to make letters or numbers on a surface, especially using a pen or a pencil

examples.x: In some countries children don't start learning to read and write until they are six.
Please write in pen on both sides of the paper.
I haven't got anything to write with.
Write your name at the top of the paper.
The teacher wrote the answers on the board.
The ‘b’ had been wrongly written as a ‘d’.

senses.definition_vi: tạo ra các chữ cái hoặc số trên một bề mặt, đặc biệt là bằng bút hoặc bút chì

senses.definition: to produce something in written form so that people can read, perform or use it, etc.

examples.x: to write a novel/song/computer program
to write an article/essay
Who was ‘The Grapes of Wrath’ written by?
Which opera did Verdi write first?
He hopes to write a book about his experiences one day.
She had to write a report on the project.
The text is very well written.
The play was originally written for British television.
I wanted to travel and then write about it.
He writes for the ‘New Yorker’ (= works as a writer).
No decision has been made at the time of writing.
She wrote him several poems.

senses.definition_vi: tạo ra một cái gì đó dưới dạng văn bản để mọi người có thể đọc, biểu diễn hoặc sử dụng, v.v.

senses.definition: to put information, a message of good wishes, etc. in a letter or an email and send it to somebody

examples.x: Bye! Don't forget to write.
I'm writing to enquire about language courses.
She wrote to him in France.
I wrote a letter to the Publicity Department.
I wrote the Publicity Department a letter.
She wrote that they were all fine.
Write me while you're away.
He wrote me that he would be arriving Monday.
They wrote thanking us for the present.

senses.definition_vi: đặt thông tin, một lời nhắn chúc tốt đẹp, v.v. vào một lá thư hoặc email và gửi cho ai đó

senses.definition: to state the information or the words mentioned

examples.x: The author writes that this theory has now been disproved.
Ancient historians wrote of a lost continent beneath the ocean.
She wrote of her life in Africa.
‘Of all my books,’ wrote Dickens, ‘I like this the best.’

senses.definition_vi: nêu rõ thông tin hoặc các từ được đề cập

senses.definition: to put information in the appropriate places on a form

examples.x: to write (out) a cheque
The doctor wrote her a prescription for more antibiotics.
I'll write you out a receipt.

senses.definition_vi: đặt thông tin vào những chỗ thích hợp trên một biểu mẫu

senses.definition: to record data in the memory of a computer

examples.x: An error was reported when he tried to write data to the file for the first time.

senses.definition_vi: ghi dữ liệu vào bộ nhớ của máy tính

senses.definition: to work correctly or in the way mentioned

examples.x: This pen won't write.

senses.definition_vi: hoạt động chính xác hoặc theo cách được đề cập

senses.definition: to be very obvious to other people from the expression on somebody’s face

examples.x: Guilt was written all over his face.

senses.definition_vi: rất rõ ràng đối với người khác từ biểu hiện trên khuôn mặt ai đó

senses.definition: to show clearly the quality mentioned or the influence of the person mentioned

examples.x: It was a performance with star quality written all over it.
This essay has got Mike written all over it.

senses.definition_vi: thể hiện rõ chất lượng được đề cập hoặc ảnh hưởng của người được đề cập

senses.definition: not especially good; ordinary

examples.x: The team’s performance was nothing to write home about.

senses.definition_vi: không đặc biệt tốt; bình thường

senses.definition: having no value, especially legally, or because one of the people involved has no intention of doing what they said they would
senses.definition_vi: không có giá trị, đặc biệt là về mặt pháp lý, hoặc vì một trong các bên liên quan không có ý định thực hiện những gì họ đã nói sẽ làm

senses.definition: used when you are stating that there is nothing more that can be said about something or that something is completely finished

examples.x: We were doing well but we ran out of money and that’s all she wrote.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn tuyên bố rằng không còn gì có thể nói về một điều gì đó hoặc rằng một điều gì đó đã hoàn toàn kết thúc

senses.definition: a person whose job is writing books, stories, articles, etc.

examples.x: Who's your favourite writer?
a travel/cookery/science fiction writer
a freelance feature writer for ‘Time’ magazine
writers of poetry/fiction
the first Russian writer to win the Nobel Prize for Literature
She left her job to become a full-time writer.

senses.definition_vi: một người có nghề viết sách, truyện, bài báo, v.v.

senses.definition: a person who has written a particular thing

examples.x: the writer of this letter
I used to be a prolific letter writer.

senses.definition_vi: một người đã viết một điều gì đó cụ thể

senses.definition: a person who forms letters in a particular way when they are writing

examples.x: a messy writer

senses.definition_vi: một người tạo ra các chữ cái theo một cách cụ thể khi họ viết

senses.definition: the activity of writing, in contrast to reading, speaking, etc.

examples.x: Our son’s having problems with his reading and writing (= at school).
a writing case (= containing paper, pens, etc.)
Every morning the children do writing.

senses.definition_vi: hoạt động viết, trái ngược với đọc, nói, v.v.

senses.definition: the activity of writing books, articles, etc., especially as a job

examples.x: Only later did she discover a talent for writing.
I wanted to try out a new style of writing.
creative writing
feminist/travel writing
He is leaving the band to concentrate on his writing.

senses.definition_vi: hoạt động viết sách, bài báo, v.v., đặc biệt là như một nghề nghiệp

senses.definition: books, articles, etc. in general

examples.x: The review is a brilliant piece of writing.

senses.definition_vi: sách, bài báo, v.v. nói chung

senses.definition: words that have been written or painted on something

examples.x: There was writing all over the desk.

senses.definition_vi: các từ đã được viết hoặc vẽ trên một cái gì đó

senses.definition: the particular way in which somebody forms letters when they write

examples.x: Who's this from? I don't recognize the writing.

senses.definition_vi: cách thức cụ thể mà một người tạo ra các chữ cái khi họ viết

senses.definition: a group of pieces of writing, especially by a particular person or on a particular subject

examples.x: His experiences in India influenced his later writings.
the writings of Hegel
His writings on complex subjects are clear and definitive.

senses.definition_vi: một nhóm các tác phẩm, đặc biệt là của một người cụ thể hoặc về một chủ đề cụ thể

senses.definition: in the form of a letter, document, etc. (that gives proof of something)

examples.x: All telephone reservations must be confirmed in writing.
Could you put your complaint in writing?
You must get it in writing.

senses.definition_vi: dưới dạng thư, tài liệu, v.v. (chứng minh điều gì đó)

senses.definition: used when you are describing a situation in which there are signs that something is going to have problems or that it is going to be a failure

examples.x: It is amazing that not one of them saw the writing on the wall.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn mô tả một tình huống có dấu hiệu cho thấy điều gì đó sắp gặp rắc rối hoặc sắp thất bại

senses.definition: expressed in writing rather than in speech

examples.x: Having a written record of what I've done is very valuable.
written instructions
The council is inviting written submissions from the public before June 19.

senses.definition_vi: được diễn đạt bằng văn bản thay vì bằng lời nói

senses.definition: involving writing rather than speaking or practical skills

examples.x: a written test
Students must submit one or more pieces of written work for assessment.
written communication skills

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến viết thay vì nói hoặc kỹ năng thực hành

senses.definition: in the form of a letter, document, etc. and therefore official

examples.x: No portion of this site may be copied without express written consent.
You must give written permission before this information can be shared.
a written apology
a written contract
In a written statement, the government has denied the claims.

senses.definition_vi: dưới dạng thư, tài liệu, v.v. và do đó là chính thức

senses.definition: language expressed in writing rather than in speech

examples.x: the permanence of the written word

senses.definition_vi: ngôn ngữ được diễn đạt bằng văn bản thay vì bằng lời nói

senses.definition: not right or correct

examples.x: I got all the answers wrong.
He was driving on the wrong side of the road.
Sorry, I must have dialled the wrong number.
You're holding the camera the wrong way up!
That picture is the wrong way round.
I soon realised I'd taken a wrong turn.
He got all his calculations wrong.
The information is just plain wrong.

senses.definition_vi: không đúng hoặc không chính xác

senses.definition: not right about something/somebody

examples.x: I think she lives at number 44, but I could be wrong.
You were wrong about Tom; he's not married after all.
We were wrong to assume that she'd agree.
She would prove him wrong (= prove that he was wrong) whatever happened.
Correct me if I'm wrong (= I may be wrong) but didn't you say you two knew each other?
If you think I'm happy, you're dead wrong.
You think you've beaten me but that's where you're wrong.
‘I thought this might interest you because I know you like boxing.’ ‘You're not wrong (= you are absolutely right). I love boxing.’

senses.definition_vi: không đúng về điều gì đó/ai đó

senses.definition: causing problems or difficulties; not as it should be

examples.x: Is anything wrong? You look worried.
‘What's wrong?’ ‘Oh, nothing.’
There's something wrong with the printer.
I have something wrong with my foot.
The doctor could find nothing wrong with him.

senses.definition_vi: gây ra vấn đề hoặc khó khăn; không như lẽ ra phải thế

senses.definition: not suitable, right or what you need

examples.x: He's the wrong person for the job.
She's simply wrong for this job.
I realized that it was the wrong thing to say.
Most people think that the country is heading in the wrong direction.
It was his bad luck to be in the wrong place at the wrong time (= so that he got involved in trouble without intending to).
We don't want this document falling into the wrong hands.
She's all wrong for you.

senses.definition_vi: không phù hợp, đúng đắn hoặc là thứ bạn cần

senses.definition: not morally right or honest

examples.x: This man has done nothing wrong.
It is wrong to tell lies.
It's morally wrong to kill somebody.
It was wrong of me to get so angry.
What's wrong with eating meat?
There's nothing inherently wrong with this type of nostalgia.
It is wrong that he should not be punished for what he did.

senses.definition_vi: không đúng đắn về mặt đạo đức hoặc không trung thực

senses.definition: to support somebody/something that is not successful
senses.definition_vi: ủng hộ ai đó/điều gì đó không thành công

senses.definition: to have the wrong idea about how to get or achieve something

examples.x: You're barking up the wrong tree if you're expecting us to lend you any money.

senses.definition_vi: có ý tưởng sai lầm về cách để đạt được điều gì đó

senses.definition: from or living in a poor area or part of town
senses.definition_vi: từ hoặc sống ở một khu vực nghèo hoặc một phần của thị trấn

senses.definition: to start a relationship well/badly

examples.x: I seem to have got off on the wrong foot with the new boss.

senses.definition_vi: bắt đầu một mối quan hệ tốt/xấu

senses.definition: to make somebody pleased with you/annoyed with you
senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó hài lòng với bạn/khó chịu với bạn

senses.definition: to be in a bad mood for the whole day for no particular reason
senses.definition_vi: ở trong tâm trạng tồi tệ cả ngày mà không có lý do cụ thể

senses.definition: to understand something in the wrong way
senses.definition_vi: hiểu sai điều gì đó

senses.definition: to do, say or write something that is suitable/not suitable for a particular occasion

examples.x: It is a bizarre tale and the author hits just the right note of horror and disbelief.
Unfortunately, the president struck the wrong note in his speech, ignoring the public mood.

senses.definition_vi: làm, nói hoặc viết điều gì đó phù hợp/không phù hợp với một dịp đặc biệt

senses.definition: almost correct

examples.x: Your guess wasn't far out at all.
They weren't far out with their estimate of 100 000.
You're not far wrong when you say he's the richest guy in town.

senses.definition_vi: gần đúng

senses.definition: younger or older than 40, 50, etc. years of age
senses.definition_vi: trẻ hơn hoặc già hơn 40, 50, v.v. tuổi

senses.definition: thinking or behaving in the right/wrong way

examples.x: We haven’t found a cure yet—but we are on the right track.
The new manager successfully got the team back onto the right track.
The police were on the wrong track when they treated the case as a revenge killing.

senses.definition_vi: suy nghĩ hoặc hành động theo cách đúng/sai

senses.definition: in trouble with the police
senses.definition_vi: gặp rắc rối với cảnh sát

senses.definition: to make somebody annoyed or angry, often without intending to, by doing or saying something that offends them

examples.x: She tends to rub people up the wrong way.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó khó chịu hoặc tức giận, thường là vô ý, bằng cách làm hoặc nói điều gì đó xúc phạm họ

senses.definition: to be offended by a remark that was not intended to be offensive

examples.x: Don't take this the wrong way, but maybe you're trying a bit too hard.

senses.definition_vi: bị xúc phạm bởi một nhận xét không có ý xúc phạm

senses.definition: in a way that produces a result that is not correct or that you do not want

examples.x: My name is spelt wrong.
The program won't load. What am I doing wrong?
I was trying to apologize but it came out wrong (= what I said sounded wrong).
‘I thought you were going out.’ ‘Well you must have thought wrong, then!’

senses.definition_vi: theo một cách tạo ra kết quả không chính xác hoặc không mong muốn

senses.definition: to not understand correctly what somebody means or what they are

examples.x: Don’t get me wrong (= do not be offended by what I am going to say), I think he’s doing a good job, but…

senses.definition_vi: không hiểu đúng ý ai đó hoặc họ là gì

senses.definition: to not understand a situation correctly

examples.x: No, you've got it all wrong. She's his wife.
You've got it all wrong. I never meant to imply that you were responsible.

senses.definition_vi: không hiểu đúng tình huống

senses.definition: to make a mistake with something

examples.x: I must have got the figures wrong.
It looks like they got their predictions wrong again.

senses.definition_vi: mắc lỗi với điều gì đó

senses.definition: to make a mistake

examples.x: If you do what she tells you, you won't go far wrong.
Where did we go wrong with those kids (= what mistakes did we make for them to behave so badly)?

senses.definition_vi: mắc lỗi

senses.definition: to stop working correctly

examples.x: My watch keeps going wrong.

senses.definition_vi: ngừng hoạt động đúng cách

senses.definition: to experience problems or difficulties

examples.x: The relationship started to go wrong when they moved abroad.
What else can go wrong (= what other problems are we going to have)?
What went wrong? You were doing really well.
Something has gone badly wrong.
to go terribly/seriously wrong

senses.definition_vi: trải qua vấn đề hoặc khó khăn

senses.definition: to make a mistake

examples.x: In the last two games he has hardly put a foot wrong.

senses.definition_vi: mắc lỗi

senses.definition: used to say that something will always be acceptable in a particular situation

examples.x: For a quick lunch you can't go wrong with pasta.
You can't go wrong with spaghetti—everyone likes it.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó sẽ luôn được chấp nhận trong một tình huống cụ thể

senses.definition: behaviour that is not honest or morally acceptable

examples.x: Children must be taught the difference between right and wrong.
Her son can do no wrong in her eyes.

senses.definition_vi: hành vi không trung thực hoặc không thể chấp nhận về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: an act that is not legal, honest or morally acceptable

examples.x: It is time to forgive past wrongs if progress is to be made.
It seems like we're righting a wrong. It's long overdue.

senses.definition_vi: một hành động không hợp pháp, trung thực hoặc không thể chấp nhận về mặt đạo đức

senses.definition: responsible for an accident, a mistake, an argument, etc.

examples.x: The motorcyclist was clearly in the wrong.
It took a lot of courage to admit that she was in the wrong.
Although he knew he was in the wrong, he wouldn't apologize.

senses.definition_vi: chịu trách nhiệm về một tai nạn, một sai lầm, một cuộc tranh cãi, v.v.

senses.definition: to do something to correct an unfair situation or something bad that you have done

examples.x: This is a time to right wrongs and heal divisions.
How can we right these wrongs?

senses.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó để sửa chữa một tình huống không công bằng hoặc một điều tồi tệ bạn đã làm

senses.definition: used to say that if somebody does something bad to you, the situation will not be improved by doing something bad to them
senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng nếu ai đó làm điều gì đó xấu với bạn, tình hình sẽ không được cải thiện bằng cách làm điều gì đó xấu với họ
